Titles.eng: Inazuma Eleven GO the Movie: The Ultimate Bonds Gryphon
Titles.jpn: 劇場版イナズマイレブンGO 究極の絆 グリフォン

Summaries.eng: The Kaminarimon Soccer Club, led by Tenma Matsukaze, continues to fight against the Fifth Sector, a soccer management organization that manages even victory and defeat. Meanwhile, the Fifth Sector ordered us to participate in the training camp. Tenma and his friends head to God Eden, an island with a vast nature area with a training camp.
Summaries.jpn: 勝敗までも管理するサッカー管理組織「フィフスセクター」に反旗を翻し戦い続ける、松風天馬率いる雷門サッカー部。そんな中、フィフスセクターから強化合宿への参加命令がくだる。天馬たちは合宿場のある広大な自然が広がる島「ゴッドエデン」へと向かい…。
